issues.description: The template uses stim.Circuit(p) when constructing a Stim circuit inside simulate_msd_two_rounds, but the problem statement and the solution use stim.Circuit() (no constructor argument). The Stim Circuit constructor does not accept a floating-point depolarization probability parameter in this way. This mismatch is likely an unintentional error in the template and will cause runtime errors or confuse students about how to construct a Circuit.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the template to construct the Stim circuit without the extra argument, i.e., replace stim.Circuit(p) with stim.Circuit(). Ensure any example code and documentation consistently construct circuits using stim.Circuit() (the depolarization parameter should be applied to specific operations such as DEPOLARIZE1, not to the Circuit constructor).
